title: Re-Verb Open Mic @ Flava Coffee & Cafe
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring soul-stirring music and poetry in partnership with TruArt Speaks. DJ JUST NINE spins beats on the first Thursday of each month. Approximately 15 performers each night.
venue_address: 623 University Ave W - St. Paul - MN 55104
event_venue_information:
About Flava Coffee & Cafe

Flava Coffee & Cafe is more than just a coffee shop – it's a community-centered cultural space in St. Paul's Frogtown neighborhood that creates opportunities for young women and gender expansive youth of color. The cafe serves as a haven where people from all walks of life can gather and connect.

Music and Cultural Events

The venue hosts the weekly Re-Verb Open Mic every Thursday evening from 6-8pm in partnership with TruArt Speaks. This extraordinary event fills the space with soul-stirring music - awe-inspiring poetry - and a strong sense of community. The Re-Verb stage has been graced by countless local and national artists.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The cafe features modern yet creative decor showcasing local Black artists - comfortable seating including couches - and a welcoming environment perfect for collaboration or focus work. Named coffee drinks honor Black feminist icons like Bell Hooks and Nina Simone. The cafe is conveniently located on the Green Line Dale Street light rail stop.

title: Open Mic Night @ Ginkgo Coffeehouse
event_description: Bi-weekly open mic hosted by Neal Dimick on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month. Local musicians play for donations in a casual coffeehouse setting. All acoustic and folk-oriented music styles welcome.
venue_address: 721 N Snelling Ave - St. Paul - MN 55104
event_venue_information:
About Ginkgo Coffeehouse

Ginkgo Coffeehouse has been serving the Twin Cities since 1993 - making it one of St. Paul's longest-running independent coffee shops. This locally owned establishment operates two locations in Midway and Downtown St. Paul.

Music Programming

The Snelling Avenue location hosts open mic nights on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month from 6-8 PM. The venue also presents the Local Musician Series featuring donation-based concerts on Friday and ticketed shows on Saturday nights. The intimate coffeehouse setting creates a welcoming environment for acoustic performances.

Venue Character

Ginkgo exudes an old-school - non-pretentious coffeehouse vibe with eclectic decor - mismatched furniture - and local artwork adorning the walls. The space serves as a vibrant gathering place for students - artists - and community members. The menu features quality coffee including specialty lattes like the Tundra Turtle - fresh pastries - sandwiches - and soups.

title: Variety Open Mic @ Camp Bar
event_description: Weekly variety open mic welcoming all types of performers including musicians - poets - magicians - and comedians. Voted Best Open Mic in St. Paul. Each performer gets 6 minutes or two songs for musicians.
venue_address: 490 N Robert St - St. Paul - MN 55101
event_venue_information:
About Camp Bar

Camp Bar opened in June 2007 and quickly became a Downtown Saint Paul landmark. This upscale cocktail bar and cabaret features a large u-shaped bar - cozy sidewalk patio - pool table - and performance stage with piano. The venue is known for generous drinks and 16 craft beers on tap.

The Cabaret at Camp

The Cabaret @ Camp is one of St. Paul's premier performing arts spaces - managed by Actors Theater of Minnesota. The intimate venue features state-of-the-art sound and lighting - dynamic seating - a unique stage with green room - and full-service bar. The space hosts professional theatrical productions - musical acts - dance parties - and nationally known stand-up comedians every weekend.

Weekly Events and Entertainment

The venue hosts Variety Open Mic on Monday nights (except the first Monday) - comedy open mic on Sundays - Music Mayhem Trivia on Wednesdays - and Trivia Mafia on Thursdays. Camp Bar is an Official Green Bay Packers Bar. The LGBTQIA+ friendly venue creates an inclusive environment for the community.

title: Greatest Jam on Earth @ Blues Saloon
event_description: Weekly blues jam session featuring a pro host band with full backline including Hammond organ. Minnesota's premier blues hall welcomes all skill levels. Large dance floor available.
backline: Full Backline - Hammond Organ - PA System
event_venue_information:
About Blues Saloon

Known as St. Paul's Legendary Blues Saloon - Wilebski's Blues Saloon is Minnesota's premier blues hall. The venue has earned recognition as one of the best live music venues in the Twin Cities - offering world-class blues performances without a cover charge.

The Greatest Jam on Earth

Every Tuesday night from 7-11 PM - the Blues Saloon hosts the Greatest Jam on Earth - an awesome blues jam session on the big stage. The venue provides a full professional backline including Hammond organ and an all-pro host band. Musicians of all skill levels are welcome to join in and showcase their talents.

Venue Features

The spacious venue features a huge dance floor right in front of the stage - four levels of seating - and an atmosphere reminiscent of New Orleans blues Americana. The colorful murals and old-school roadhouse decor create an authentic blues experience. The Blues Saloon serves delicious food including burgers and wings - along with great tap selections. Overflow parking is available in the shopping center across the street.

title: Open Stage @ Minnesota Music Cafe
event_description: Monthly open stage and cool stuff bazaar on the first Wednesday of each month. All styles welcome - acoustic oriented. Musicians can join the band - play solo - or bring their own band. Crafters and artists welcome to display creations.
event_venue_information:
About Minnesota Music Cafe

Minnesota Music Cafe is voted #2 best concert venue in Minnesota. This down-to-earth live music venue in St. Paul's Payne-Phalen neighborhood has a capacity of 360 people and specializes in blues - R&B - and rock shows.

Open Stage Events

The Twin Cities' only Open Stage and Cool Stuff Bazaar takes place on the first Wednesday of each month from 6-9 PM. Musicians can join in with the house band - perform solo - or bring their own band. The event is acoustic-oriented but welcomes all styles. Artists - crafters - creators - and flea marketers are invited to bring their creations to display and sell.

Venue Atmosphere

The venue features a full bar - pub fare - and an intimate atmosphere perfect for experiencing live music up close. The cafe regularly hosts blues - R&B - rock - and roots music performances. With great sound quality and a welcoming environment - Minnesota Music Cafe has become a beloved fixture in St. Paul's music scene.
